title: The Calloway rhythm section and Danny Barker
summary: They name the rhythm section of Bennie Payne, Hinton, Cozy Cole and Danny Barker and talk about Barker's tune and later career in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, I remember that band now because I was there with you. Let's see, the rhythm -- Who was that rhythm section? When I was there it was Ben --
It was Bennie Payne and you and Cozy Colezie --
You know, we just heard a tune of his.
'Henry Jones, because Henry don't eat no meat.'
Not long ago we heard that, didn't we?
He's doing very well in New Orleans now.
Oh, I know. I know he is.
He's got a great book out.
Uh-huh, and he's -- I don't know, he's been working for that man in that club I don't know how many years, you know.
Yeah. He was up a few months ago. I got to see him for a minute.
